verdict.rationale: incident.io's docs reference an 'Insights' feature that lets users view data over Week/Month/Quarter periods and compare to previous periods, implying some trend analytics exist, but the evidence never names MTTA/MTTR, incident load, or on-call health metrics specifically, nor shows dashboards/reports demonstrating improvement tracking. Missing for 10: explicit mention of MTTA/MTTR metrics, on-call health scoring, incident load trend visualizations, and any hands-on or customer proof of using these analytics to show improvement over time.
